I5.quote: Here, we report the fabrication of a graphene-wrapped nanostructured reactive hydride composite, i.e., 2LiBH4-MgH2, made by adopting graphene-supported MgH2 nanoparticles (NPs) as the nanoreactor and heterogeneous nucleation sites.

notes: Hydrogenation uptake is measured volumetrically (Sieverts apparatus, 350 C, 8 MPa initial) only on LBMH80@G (80 wt% 2LiBH4-MgH2 on graphene, so about 20 wt% graphene) and on ball-milled bulk 2LiBH4-MgH2. Protocol section 3 states hydrides are not carbon sorbents and carbon is the minority component of LBMH80@G, so I2 fails. LBMH40@G (theoretical 4.56 wt% = 40% of 11.4 wt%) and LBMH60@G have only dehydrogenation (TGA-MS, Fig. 4a-c, Fig. S6) data, no uptake. I1 was coded met because hydrogenation uptake is measured, not merely a reaction without a measured uptake; if I1 were read as excluding reactive-hydride absorption, the code would be no_conditions_stated instead. The BET area (794.7 m2/g) is for MH20@G, not the H2 uptake sample. Not retracted (is_retracted false; no retraction text). No statement that the uptake data were published before.
